source_title: First Look Teaser for 'Death Stranding Isolations' Sci-Fi Anime Series
source_excerpt:
"My mom became a crater." Disney+/Hulu unveiled the first look teaser trailer for a new sci-fi anime series titled Death Stranding Isolations , yet another new Death Stranding spin-off from Kojima Productions. This one is finishing up and ready to debut in 2027 . In addition to this series, they've also got another new Death Stranding: Mosquito anime movie project in the works as well. The "Death Stranding" – catastrophic series of explosions caused when the dead crept into our world and collided with the living. In the wake of this cataclysm, many were forced to live in absolute isolation—among them is a young girl. Although this lonely existence was forced upon her, she soon grows to prefer solitude, eschewing all opportunities for real human connection and allowing herself to be strung along by fate. Under the guidance of director Takayuki Sano , world-class hand-drawn animations have been brought to life by renowned studio E&H. The story is set in North America immediately after Sam—the protagonist of the video game —reconnects the continent by means of the Chiral Network. However, as America is reborn from the ashes, the renewed connections that bind it together bring about new and unforeseen consequences. No voice cast or other info is confirmed yet – for now we only have this glimpse of footage as a sneak peek of what's coming next year. Have a look.
Here's the teaser trailer (+ poster) for Takayuki Sano's anime Death Stranding Isolations , via YouTube :
Intro: Once, there was an explosion... Lonesome souls of the dead manifest in the physical world, reaching in search of the living. However, the connection they create triggers a massive explosion that eradicates anything of this world a phenomenon referred to as the Death Stranding. These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink a legendary porter set out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved. Death Stranding Isolations is a new anime series created by Death Stranding's Hideo Kojima & Kojima Productions. The series is directed by anime filmmaker Takayuki Sano , of animation work on One Punch Man , Kakegurui , Attack on Titan , Gridman Universe , and Bullet/Bullet most recently. With concept art by Ilya Kuvshinov (character designer for Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 ) and produced by E&H Production. Disney+ debuts this Death Stranding Isolations series streaming on Disney+ worldwide starting in 2027 . Stay tuned for more updates. How does that look?
